description: History accumulates, a summary checkpoint is taken, the writer restarts through a graceful protocol shutdown, and a later prompt continues. Passing requires a post-restart preparation to dispatch a request from a checkpoint this Attempt's own evidence established -- proving the successor Assembly loaded the same Session and continued the chain rather than replaying raw history. A restart action in the Scenario is the request, never the proof.
